question: how do i find out why my financial aid hasnt shown up yet and who do i talk to

body.answer:
The Office of Financial Aid is the right place to ask about your individual account; I don’t have verified information about why your aid hasn’t appeared. Most questions can be handled by phone, Webex or email. You can email or use the chat on its website to make an in-person appointment; those appointments are Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 4:30pm. If your family circumstances have changed or you’re experiencing financial hardship, email or call to discuss a possible re-evaluation of your award. [9]

For information about how aid appears on your account, click “here” at [https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) and then click “Billing and Financial Aid Terminology.” [1] Estimated aid is not disbursed until one week after the 50% refund period has ended. [45]

**Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [50]

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts: For Spring 2027, choose the four- or five-month Ramapo Tuition Payment Plan. Enroll online by logging into [RCNJ Experience](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/) and using the Bill & Payment Suite; the suite is where students can enroll in a monthly payment plan. [1][36] Enrollment and the down payment are due by December 16, 2026. [1][40]

The five-month plan requires a 20% down payment; the four-month plan requires 25%. Both are due at enrollment, along with a non-refundable $60 set-up fee. Further installments are due on the 15th of each month. [1]

Past-semester balances of $500 or more must be paid before you are eligible; the College may deny enrollment based on past payment history. If you enroll after the down-payment due date, missed installments are due at enrollment. Missing the enrollment deadline may result in a $200 late fee and/or deregistration. [1]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [54]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [36](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) [40](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/) [54](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [30]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

**Registrar:** A student may not withdraw after the published deadline. Before that deadline, a withdrawal after the 50% refund period may be made through Web Self Service, using an online withdrawal form, or by completing a course withdrawal form in the Registrar’s Office [11, 15].

For extraordinary circumstances beyond your control that prevented a timely withdrawal, you may apply for a late administrative withdrawal through the **Office of the Provost**. Submit an appeal letter in your own words, with official documentation, no later than the last day of classes of the regular (fall or spring) semester following the term you want withdrawn. Explain the extraordinary circumstances, why you could not use standard withdrawal procedures or obtain incompletes, and the term. Examples include personal illness, a family member’s death or terminal illness, recovery from catastrophe or natural disaster, or immediate employer-required relocation. If appropriate, consider asking instructors for incompletes or applying for a Medical Leave of Absence [12, 16].

**Financial Aid:** Withdrawing from a course may affect financial-aid eligibility [11]. The Financial Aid page advises meeting with its office to discuss whether and how a withdrawal may affect your aid. Its federal Title IV rule described there applies to students who withdraw from all classes or leave school before 60% of a semester has concluded [1].

**Satisfactory academic progress (SAP):** A course withdrawal may affect progress toward graduation [11]. For financial-aid SAP, students must complete at least 67% of attempted credits; review is annual after spring semester. The page also gives minimum cumulative GPAs of 2.0 for undergraduates and 3.0 for graduate students [2]. The pages don’t establish the specific effect on your aid or SAP; contact Financial Aid to discuss your situation [1].

- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [31]
- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [31]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/faqs/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/) [11](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [12](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#withdrawal-or-leave-of-absence-from-the-college) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [16](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [30](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

Student Accounts says Form 1098-T is provided each year on or before January 31; eligibility requires qualified tuition and related expenses and corresponding payments during the tax year. The page can’t confirm whether your individual form is available yet. [2]

question: im a transfer student and i commute, how do i get a parking permit and where do i park

body.answer:
Orientation Programs’ permit instructions say all students parking on campus need a current, valid permit. Apply online at the [Parking Permits website](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/): log on, enter Permit Type and click Continue; complete Contact Information, click Save/Update Person, then Continue; enter Vehicle Information and Continue; review your request and Continue. Print or save the Registration Filed page with your request number; it verifies your application but is not the permit. Select the correct commuter status and “student,” not “faculty/staff.” [1]

Public Safety says to ensure the parking fee is on your student account and visit the permit site. Commuters receive a rearview mirror hang tag; you may register two vehicles on one permit, but only one registered vehicle may be parked on campus at a time. Each vehicle must be registered. [1][7] The fee and applicable tax are billed to your term bill; off-campus students are charged 6.63% sales tax on parking fees. [25]

New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In. Returning commuters pick them up at the Public Safety ID Office Monday through Friday during normal operating hours, or at the Public Safety Office Main Desk after 3 pm if they email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request another pickup time. [1][7]

As a commuter, park in B1, B2, or B3. If your assigned lot is full, students may use C1, C2, or D as overflow. Commuters may not leave a vehicle overnight (2am–6am) without prior Public Safety authorization. [12]

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [25](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/parking/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I'm a commuter student and I have a 3 hour gap between classes. Is there somewhere on campus I can study or hang out, like a commuter lounge, and is there a way to store my stuff?

body.answer:
J. Lee’s is the unofficial Commuter Lounge, on the second floor of the Student Center between the Student Government office and the Black Student Union office. It has video games, a pool table, ping pong, and free popcorn. [1]

The Women’s Center & LGBTQ+ Services lounge in Room C-220 welcomes students to hang out, socialize, or study during open hours. [18]

For storage, the Center for Student Involvement says students may rent small or medium lockers by going to the Student Center Office. Lockers are in the second-floor stairwell between B and C buildings. The fee is $10.00 for the semester or $20.00 for the academic year. You receive a key with payment, and must return it at the end of the semester. [6]

question: what is the deadline to drop a class without a W and how do i do it

body.answer:
I can't send messages or make changes for you, like registering, dropping a class or making a payment.

The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [31]:
- Friday, August 28, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Tuesday, September 1, 2026: Full Semester Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Wednesday, October 21, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Thursday, December 17, 2026: Last Day to Add/Drop Winter Classes with 100% Tuition Refund (also on the Winter 2027 calendar)

The no-W deadline is the last day of the Add/Drop period for your course session; the date depends on the term/session. The Fall 2026 dates already listed have passed. Check the Academic Calendar for the applicable date [2][3][7].

The Registrar says you can drop online in Web Self Service through that deadline [3][7]. During the 50% refund period, you can use Web Self Service or submit a 50% Drop Form to the Office of the Registrar; the course will not appear on your transcript [3][7]. See the Registrar’s “Dropping a Course” instructions: [https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/06/Dropping-a-Course.pdf](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/06/Dropping-a-Course.pdf) [3].

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [32]

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Yes. Ramapo residents may host up to two guests at a time. Each registered guest may stay no more than three nights (consecutively or not) in a seven-day period; a night begins and ends at 10:00 PM. Current RCNJ residential students do not need to register as guests. Overnight guests are not permitted on campus after Monday, December 14, 2026. [3][6]

Talk with your roommate about your guest expectations. To opt out of the automatic guest-registration arrangement, contact your Resident Assistant (RA) to facilitate a roommate/suitemate/apartment contract. If the contract is violated, staff in the hall/area office must receive a formal complaint before they can act. The page says to alert the guest’s host about concerns. [3]

For an alleged violation of the Guide to Community Living, file a complaint with the Office of Residence Life. [22]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [31]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [32]

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/fallcheckoutandwinter/) [22](https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/student-complaints-of-a-non-academic-nature/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i get a parking permit and how much does it cost

body.answer:
Apply online through the [Parking Permits registration portal](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [1, 7, 8]. To complete the application: log on; enter Permit Type and click Continue; complete Contact Information, click Save/Update Person, then Continue; enter Vehicle Information and click Continue; review the request and click Continue; print or save the Registration Filed page with your request number. It verifies your application but is not your permit. Select the correct housing assignment or commuter status, and select “student,” not “faculty/staff.” [1] All students parking on campus need a current, valid permit. Commuters may register two vehicles on one permit at no extra fee, but only one may be parked on campus at a time. [1, 6]
New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In; returning residents get them from their on-campus mailbox; returning commuters pick them up at the Public Safety ID Office during weekday operating hours, or after 3 pm at the Public Safety Office Main Desk if they email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request a different time. [1, 6]
For 2026–2027, the Fall/Spring permit is $250 (valid through Spring 2027); a new-student Spring-only permit is $125; a Summer-only permit is $100. Resident supplements are $50 for Fall/Spring and $25 for Spring-only. [19] Parking fees are charged to your term bill, not paid when applying. [7] Off-campus students are charged 7% sales tax on parking fees; on-campus students are exempt. [7]

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

For a full-semester course, the regular withdrawal deadline has passed; the Registrar says a student may not withdraw after the published deadline. For a course whose deadline is still upcoming, withdraw online through [Web Self Service](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf). If you have a registration hold, use the [Withdrawal Form](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2025/02/Withdrawal-Form-FILLABLE.pdf) or email reg@ramapo.edu from your Ramapo account with your first and last name, R#, CRN, subject, course number, section number, and course title. Instructor permission is not required. After the refund period, a withdrawal is recorded as a “W” on your transcript and there is no refund. [7]

If extraordinary circumstances beyond your control prevented a timely withdrawal, the Office of the Provost accepts late administrative withdrawal appeals. No later than the last day of classes of the regular fall or spring semester following the term, submit an appeal letter in your own words with official documentation. Explain the circumstances, why you could not follow standard withdrawal procedures or request/receive incompletes, and which term you want withdrawn. Typically, an approved appeal results in W grades in all courses for that term. [8]

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]

Sources: [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

**Housing & Residence Life**

value.page_words: If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM or Public Safety after these hours at extension 6666. If utilizing the online system on your own, please send only one request per issue. Our system will send automatic email notifications to the sender when the request is processed, when the status changes and when the work is complete. If you have any questions or concerns regarding your request, you may call our Service Desk at extension 7660; please reference the request number generated by the system when you call. return to top Asbestos: The College Park apartments were built before 1980, and some of their construction materials contain asbestos. Buckeye, Holly, International, Mimosa, Elm, Palm, Redwood, Hickory, Science, Mulberry, and Cypress have been renovated and are asbestos-free. Materials that contain asbestos include floor tiles/mastic and joint compound in walls and ceilings. These materials present no hazard unless they are impaired or disturbed. Puncturing these materials could cause a release of asbestos fibers. Please do not insert nails, tacks, hooks or otherwise impair or disturb the materials. If you notice any damage, please vacate the apartment

I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

question: My RA wrote me up for a candle. what happens now? do i have to go to a hearing

body.answer:
Candles are prohibited in residences, and students who violate fire-safety rules may face disciplinary action [20]. If the candle activated a fire alarm, the listed sanction is a $150 fine and Fire Safety Reflection for a first offense; a second offense is a $300 fine, disciplinary probation, and possible suspension or loss of housing privileges [2]. The pages don’t say what happens in your specific case or whether your write-up requires a hearing. A meeting with a Hearing Officer or College Disciplinary Review Board is an opportunity to talk about what happened [8].

Contact the Office of Student Conduct to ask whether a hearing is required in your case. If you have a hearing, you may review the incident reports and written statements to be used, submit documents or statements beforehand, and bring an advisor who may confer privately but may not speak during the hearing [1].

- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [34]
- **Office of Student Conduct**: Phone: (201) 684-7869. Email: studentconduct@ramapo.edu. Office: C-212. [34]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/hearing/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/fire-safety/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/frequently-asked-questions/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [34](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: Do I still owe anything to the college? I need to clear my balance before graduation

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

I can’t verify whether you personally owe a balance. The Office of Student Accounts says students with balances cannot receive a diploma and/or transcript until paid [3]. An outstanding balance also places a Hold Flag on your account; it is removed once your account is paid in full [15].

To check, use the Student Accounts “How to View and Pay Your Bill?” video guide [12]. On the Account Summary screen, “Current Due Net of Authorized Financial Aid and Memos” is the amount to be paid [35]. Pending aid appears separately; aid shown as a Memo may require further action, so contact the Office of Financial Aid about unresolved aid issues. Estimated aid from a prior term will not appear on a current term bill [35].

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
Student Accounts says that, unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check. Title IV aid credit balances of $1.00 or greater are refunded; non-Title IV aid credit balances have a $5.00 threshold. Checks go to your billing/permanent address, not a campus mailbox, and cannot be picked up at the office. [1]

Direct deposit is optional and free. To sign up: [1][2]
1. “Log into RCNJ Experience” [3]
2. “Locate the Student Account Info card” [3]
3. “Click on Bill & Payment Suite” [3]
4. “Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu” [3]
5. “You must enroll in a Two-Step Verification Process (If previously completed, skip this step)” [3]
6. In My Profile, use the Security Settings tab to select a passcode method, send and verify the code. [3]
7. On the Payment Profile tab, edit or create a payment method and check the Refund Option box. [3]

The page says an eligible refund is typically deposited within one to two weeks after submitting the application. [2]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [32]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill

body.answer:
Student Accounts: Go to [Authorized User setup](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/users/) and follow these steps [4]:
1. “Log into RCNJ Experience” ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)).
2. “Locate the Student Account Info card” and “Click on Bill & Payment Suite link.”
3. “Click on Authorized Users located on the right side of the page in the My Profile Setup section.”
4. “Click on the Add Authorized User tab.”
5. “Enter the email address of the desired authorized user, answer questions, and click the Continue button.”
6. “Click I Agree box then the Continue button.”

To allow your parent to make payments but not view your bill or payment history, select “No” for both “View billing statement” and “View payment history” [3]. An Authorized User can make payments on your behalf. Adding one does not let Student Accounts discuss your financial records with them; to permit that, submit the Office of Student Accounts FERPA Waiver Form [1].

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Contact the Office of Residence Life to request a room change; room and board changes must be handled through that office. [9]

1. Review the Room Change Process: [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) and the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar to understand how a change might affect you. [1]
2. Submit the Room Change Request Form during the open room-change period. The online form is here: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog). [2,5]
3. For this period, the form is available Thursday, 11/12/26; submissions are due no later than 12:00 pm Tuesday, 11/24/26. Outcomes will be emailed by 4:30 pm Friday, 12/4/26. Approved changes take effect on Spring 2027 Check-in Day, 1/18/27. You must completely vacate your current assignment at the end of Fall semester when you check out. Dates are subject to change. [6]

Room changes are not guaranteed; decisions depend on available space and other factors, and are made by professional Residence Life staff. [1] If approved, prorated housing charges and any applicable meal-plan changes will be assessed and adjusted on your student account. [2]

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [33]
- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [33]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [34]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/new-student-guide/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [34](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: can alumni still use career services and the library after graduating

body.answer:
Yes. The Office of Alumni Relations says alumni can use online library services, borrow books, and access the Learning Commons. See the [Library](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/) for more information, or download [Library Benefits](https://www.ramapo.edu/alumni/wp-content/uploads/sites/195/2013/08/Library-Benefits.doc). [1]

Alumni can access the Cahill Career Center’s services on campus, including help with job searches, resume updates, and interviewing skills. The college also says alumni can receive career guidance and resume help. [2][9][12] For additional information, contact the Cahill Career Center at (201) 684-7444 or careercenter@ramapo.edu. [2]

question: how do i find out why my financial aid hasnt shown up yet and who do i talk to

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status. Money stress is really common, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

Student Accounts: Check the Account Summary screen. Pending (estimated/anticipated) aid appears separately from Authorized Aid. Authorized Aid has met payment requirements and is credited on the official term disbursement date, typically four weeks into a term. [2] To see the terminology, use [Billing and Financial Aid Terminology](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/). [1]

If aid appears as a Memo, it may need further action. New Jersey Class Loans, Alternative Loans, and Outside Scholarships are exceptions; for other Memo aid, contact the Office of Financial Aid to resolve outstanding issues. Estimated aid from a prior term won’t appear on the current term bill. [2]

I can’t verify the reason in your individual account. The Office of Financial Aid is the office to ask. You can request an appointment by email or through the chat on its website; in-person appointments are Monday through Friday, 8:30am to 4:30pm. Most questions can also be handled by phone, Webex, or email. [20]

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [36]
- **Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [36]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/) [36](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts offers Spring 2027 four- and five-month plans. Enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience before the semester’s posted payment deadline. The [Tuition Payment Plans page](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) has the details. [1]

At enrollment, pay the non-refundable $60 set-up fee and a down payment: 20% for the five-month plan or 25% for the four-month plan. Further installments are due on the 15th of each month. Enrolling after the down-payment due date requires paying missed installments then. Past-due balances from previous semesters of $500 or more must be paid before you’re eligible. Missing the payment deadline may result in a $200 late fee and/or deregistration. [1]

Questions: contact Student Accounts.

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [35]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [35](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: whats the deadline to file the FAFSA for next year and what does ramapo need from me besides that

body.answer:
For the 2027–2028 FAFSA, new students should apply no later than May 1; returning students should apply by April 1. [19] Use Ramapo’s FAFSA school code, 009344, and apply at [https://studentaid.gov/](https://studentaid.gov/). [1]

Ramapo says students must complete all financial aid forms in a timely manner. [3] If you’re applying to EOF, you must submit the FAFSA (or, if you’re a qualified NJ undocumented student, the NJ Alternative Financial Aid Application) listing Ramapo, and activate your NJFAMS account. Additional documents may be required based on your status. [7]

**Financial Aid**: Phone: (201) 684-7549. Email: finaid@ramapo.edu. Office: E-210. [29]

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [30]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

The Registrar’s policy says a student may not withdraw after the published deadline [15]. For an exception, the Office of the Provost allows a late administrative withdrawal only for extraordinary circumstances that prevented withdrawal under standard procedures or prevented incompletes [16]. Submit an appeal letter in your own words with official documentation to the Office of the Provost no later than the last day of classes of the regular semester following the term. Explain the circumstances, why standard withdrawal or an incomplete was not possible, and the term you seek to withdraw from [16]. Typically, approval means W grades in all courses for that term; exceptions may be considered [16].

A course withdrawal may affect financial aid and satisfactory progress toward graduation [11]. The Financial Aid page says withdrawing from all classes or leaving school before 60% of a semester concludes can require returning some Title IV aid; it recommends meeting with Financial Aid about possible effects on your current aid [1]. Its published details do not establish the effect on your particular aid for one class withdrawn after the deadline. For SAP, aid eligibility is reviewed annually after spring; students must complete at least 67% of attempted credits and meet the GPA standard (undergraduates 2.0; graduates 3.0) [2]. The pages don’t determine your individual aid or SAP outcome.

Financial Aid recommends discussing your current aid with its office [1].

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [31]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [31]

question: im a transfer student and i commute, how do i get a parking permit and where do i park

body.answer:
Orientation Programs says all students parking on campus need a current, valid permit. Apply online at the [RCNJ Parking Permits website](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/). Log on, enter Permit Type and click Continue; complete Contact Information, click Save/Update Person, then Continue; enter Vehicle Information and Continue; review the request and Continue. Print or save the Registration Filed page with your request number as application verification; it is not your permit. Select “student” and your correct commuter status. Commuters can register two vehicles on one hang tag at no additional fee, but each vehicle must be registered and only one may be parked on campus at a time. Permit fees are charged to your student account. New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In; returning commuters pick them up at the Public Safety ID Office during normal weekday hours, or at the Public Safety Office Main Desk after 3 pm if they email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request another pickup time. For parking permit questions, email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu or call (201) 684-7432. [1][7]

Public Safety says commuters may park in lots B1, B2, and B3. If your assigned lot is full, students may use C1, C2, or D lots as overflow. Commuters may not leave a vehicle parked overnight (2am – 6am) without prior authorization from Public Safety. [7][12]

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

J. Lee’s is the unofficial Commuter Lounge, located on the second floor of the Student Center between the Student Government office and the Black Student Union office. For storage, rent a small or medium locker at the Student Center Office. Lockers are in the second-floor stairwell area between B and C buildings. The fee is $10.00 for the semester or $20.00 for the academic year. You receive a key with payment and must return it at the end of the semester. [6]

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Housing & Residence Life’s guest policy says each registered guest may stay on campus no more than three (3) nights within a seven (7) day period, consecutively or not; a night begins and ends at 10:00 PM. Current RCNJ residential students do not need to be registered as a guest. Guests must remain with their resident host. [3] For Fall 2026, the last night residents may host overnight guests is Monday, December 14, 2026; overnight guests are not permitted after that date. [6]

The College assumes roommates agree to allow guests unless they opt out. Contact your Resident Assistant to facilitate a roommate/suitemate/apartment contract. Talk with your roommate about guest expectations. If the contract is violated, staff in the hall/area office must receive a formal complaint before acting; once received, all residents of the space may lose guest privileges until they develop a contract. [3] You can also contact Housing & Residence Life. [3] Students who violate the Guest Policy may be referred to the Office of Student Conduct and may be subject to a campus restriction ban. [4]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [31]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [32]

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/fallcheckoutandwinter/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course session: the full-semester and Session I deadlines have passed; the Session II deadline has not [32]. You may not withdraw after the published deadline [7].

The Registrar says that after the refund period, a withdrawal is recorded as a “W” on your transcript, with no refund; instructor permission is not required [7]. To withdraw by the deadline, use [Web Self Service instructions](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf) [7]. If you have a registration hold, use the [Withdrawal Form](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2025/02/Withdrawal-Form-FILLABLE.pdf) or email reg@ramapo.edu from your Ramapo email with your name, Ramapo ID (R#), CRN, subject, course number, section number, and course title [7].

The College strongly urges you to seek advisement, as appropriate, from your instructor, academic advisor, and/or relevant professional staff; withdrawing may affect financial aid eligibility, progress toward graduation, athletic compliance, housing, or campus activities [1].

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

value.heading: Report a motor vehicle accident on campus
value.text: 1. Report every motor vehicle accident occurring on campus to Public Safety. (page: “All motor vehicle accidents occurring on campus must be reported to the Public Safety Department.”) 2. Know that Public Safety will notify Mahwah Police when someone is injured, significant property damage occurs in the officer’s judgment, or a vehicle owner requests police assistance. (page: “Public Safety will notify the Mahwah Police Department whenever bodily injury has occurred, or when in the judgment of the Public Safety Officer significant property damage has taken place to one or more vehicles, or if the owner of one of the vehicles requests police assistance.”) 3. For an insurance claim, note that a Police Accident Report may require Mahwah Police to respond; an RCNJ incident report may not be accepted. (page: “When filing an insurance claim for damage to a vehicle, insurance companies may request a Police Accident Report. The Mahwah Police Department must respond in order to prepare a Police Accident Report. RCNJ Public Safety Incident Reports may not be acceptable when filing an insurance claim.”)
value.section_words: All motor vehicle accidents occurring on campus must be reported to the Public Safety Department. Public Safety will notify the Mahwah Police Department whenever bodily injury has occurred, or when in the judgment of the Public Safety Officer significant property damage has taken place to one or more vehicles, or if the owner of one of the vehicles requests police assistance. In cases of personal injury, Public Safety Officers will render basic first aid and if necessary, will call for appropriate medical services to respond. If the Mahwah Police Department responds, and prepares a motor vehicle accident report, a copy of that report is available from the Town of Mahwah. The Mahwah Police Department is located at 221 Franklin Turnpike, Mahwah, NJ 07430. The MPD can be reached by phone at 201.529.1000. IMPORTANT NOTE: When filing an insurance claim for damage to a vehicle, insurance companies may request a Police Accident Report. The Mahwah Police Department must respond in order to prepare a Police Accident Report. RCNJ Public Safety Incident Reports may not be acceptable when filing an insurance claim. Additionally, the Public Safety Department may not be able to release incident reports to an insurance company due to federal student privacy regulations. All larcenies/ thefts and vehicle damage should be reported to Public Safety when discovered. Do not leave personal property in view in a parked vehicle. Lock valuable items in the vehicle’s trunk or other well-concealed areas. Lost or stolen property should be reported to Public Safety (C-102) as soon as possible. NOTE: The State of New Jersey does not indemnify vehicle owners or drivers for damage to their vehicle or for lost or stolen items inside the vehicle. Vehicle owners must carry private insurance to cover these contingencies.
value.page_words: In addition, Public Safety vehicles and Facilities vehicles may use walkways for access to campus spaces only when conducting official business. Drivers of any emergency/public safety/facilities vehicles operating on a walkway must exercise due caution for the public. IMPORTANT NOTES: Traffic citations may be issued by both Mahwah Township Police AND Ramapo College of New Jersey Public Safety. There is no “Double Jeopardy” exception, since citations issued by the Mahwah Police Department are for violations of NJ State Title 39, and citations issued by the RCNJ Department of Public Safety are for violations of RCNJ’s Motor Vehicle Rules and Regulations. A violator will be responsible for both violations, and the outcome of each will have no bearing on the other. Both violations have separate standards of proof. RCNJ moving violations are not recorded on a violator’s driving abstract in the state of issuance of the driver’s license and carry no points against the violator’s license. Motorcycles, motorbikes, and motor scooters are subject to the same regulations as four-wheeled vehicles, except that they are to be parked in a specially designated motorcycle parking area, which is located in the Mackin/Bischoff lot. Under no circumstances may two-wheeled vehicles be parked or operated on sidewalks, grassy areas or in any area not authorized for a four- wheeled motor vehicle. All

question: whats my current balance and do i have any holds on my account

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

I can’t verify your personal balance or whether you currently have holds. Your eBill is a statement of your account at a given point in time; payments or charges since it was produced can change what you owe. From the eBill page, click “activity since your last statement” to see later activity. [5] The College also has a video guide on how to view and pay your bill: [https://vimeo.com/1215865905/a43199e3fe?share=copy&fl=cl&fe=ci](https://vimeo.com/1215865905/a43199e3fe?share=copy&fl=cl&fe=ci) [13]

Office of Student Accounts: An unpaid outstanding balance can result in a Hold Flag; other offices or departments may also place holds. Contact Student Accounts to ask about your balance and account holds. [4]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [31]

Sources: [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/payment-policies/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/billpolicies/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
You don’t have to sign up for direct deposit. Unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check mailed to your billing/permanent address; checks are not mailed to campus mailboxes and cannot be picked up at Student Accounts. A Title IV aid overpayment results in a refund for a credit balance of $1.00 or greater; non-Title IV financial aid credit balances are subject to a $5.00 threshold. [1]

Electronic/direct deposit is free and deposits refunds into your checking or savings account. You can expect a refund within one to two weeks after submitting the application, if eligible. [1][2]

To sign up: [Electronic Refunds](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/): [3]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience.
2. Locate the Student Account Info card; click on Bill & Payment Suite.
3. Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu.
4. Enroll in Two-Step Verification (skip if previously completed): click Security Settings in My Profile, select a passcode method, click Send Code, enter the passcode, then click Verify.
5. Click Payment Profile in My Profile. Edit an existing payment method or create a new one; check the box in the Refund Option section to designate it as the refund account for direct deposit. [3]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [32]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Contact Housing & Residence Life. Submit a Room Change Request Form during the open room change period; room changes are not guaranteed, and professional Residence Life staff make the final decisions. [1][2] The form is available now, starting Thursday, 11/12/26, and submissions are due no later than 12:00 pm on Tuesday, 11/24/26. Outcomes will be emailed by 4:30 pm on Friday, 12/4/26. If approved, you move to your new assignment on Spring 2027 Check-in Day, 1/18/27; you must completely vacate your current assignment at the end of Fall semester when you check out. Dates are subject to change. [6]

Review the full process and check the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar to see how a change might affect you: [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) and [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/). [1] Submit the online Room Change Request Form: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog). [5] If approved, prorated housing charges and any applicable meal-plan changes will be assessed and adjusted on your student account. [2] All room and board changes must be done through Residence Life. [9]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [33]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [34]

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

Contact each instructor after your absence to account for it and ask whether and when missed work may be made up. Each instructor determines their attendance policy; OSS can consult with you and faculty about what is appropriate if the absences relate to a medical disability. [4]

The Office of Specialized Services (OSS) is the office mentioned for that consultation. The pages provided don’t verify that any office sends an excuse note for hospitalization. [4]

**Office of Specialized Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7514. Email: oss@ramapo.edu. Location: C-Wing, Room 205. [54]

These offices can help:
- **Health Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7536. Location: Near the campus South Gate entrance at the corner of Route 202 and Hornbeam Road. [55]
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [55]

question: how do i get a work study job on campus? i have it in my aid package but idk where to apply

The On-Campus Employment for Students office says to register on Handshake to view open positions, use the keyword “RCNJ” to search, and follow each posting’s application instructions to apply directly to the hiring unit. If offered a position and you accept, you and the supervisor sign an employment form; return all required paperwork (New hire packet, W-4 Form and I-9 Form) to the Student Assistant Program Office in Room D-119. [1] Federal Work-Study recipients may earn up to the award specified by Financial Aid in the award letter for the academic year. [3]

body.answer:
For Spring 2027, the four- and five-month plans become available November 16, 2026. Enroll online before the semester’s posted payment deadline by logging into RCNJ Experience. question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [30]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

The Registrar says a student may NOT withdraw after the published deadline [15]. If you mean seeking an exception, extraordinary circumstances beyond your control may qualify for a late administrative withdrawal. Submit an appeal letter in your own words, supported by official documentation, to the Office of the Provost no later than the last day of classes of the regular (fall or spring) semester following the term. Explain the circumstances, why standard procedures or incompletes were unavailable, and the term you wish to withdraw from. Typically, a successful appeal results in W grades for all courses in that term [16].
Withdrawing may affect financial aid and satisfactory progress toward graduation [11]. The Office of Financial Aid says students who withdraw from all classes before 60% of a semester concludes are subject to federal rules determining how much Title IV aid they may retain and must return; it highly recommends discussing any class withdrawal with Financial Aid [1]. Federal aid requires enrollment in 6 credits in a semester; falling below full-time status may reduce or remove aid [3]. SAP is reviewed annually after spring. To meet its quantitative standard, students must complete at least 67% of attempted credits toward graduation requirements; not meeting SAP can make you ineligible for aid [2].
Contact the Office of the Provost about an extraordinary-circumstances appeal, the Registrar about withdrawal procedures, and Financial Aid about your aid and SAP implications.

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [31]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [31]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/faqs/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/policies/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/finaid/faqs/) [11](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [16](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [30](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

A 1098-T is furnished to students who incurred qualified tuition and related expenses and paid corresponding payments during the tax year. [2]

question: im a transfer student and i commute, how do i get a parking permit and where do i park

body.answer:
Public Safety’s parking-permit information says all students parking on campus need a current, valid permit. The parking fee is charged to your student account; make sure it has been applied before using the Parking Permits webpage: [https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/). [12][13]

Apply online at that page: log on, enter Permit Type and click Continue; complete Contact Information, click Save/Update Person, then Continue; enter Vehicle Information and Continue; review your request and Continue; then print or save the Registration Filed page with your request number as verification. It is not your permit. Select the correct commuter status and “student,” not “faculty/staff.” Commuters receive a rearview-mirror hang tag and may register two vehicles on one permit at no extra fee, but each vehicle must be registered and only one may be parked on campus at a time. [1][12]

Permits for new students are available for pickup during New Student Check-In. [1][12]

As a commuter, park in B1, B2, or B3. If your assigned lot is full, students may use C1, C2, or D as overflow. Commuters may not leave a vehicle overnight (2am–6am) without prior authorization from Public Safety. [12][15]

- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [13](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/how-to-apply-for-a-parking-permit/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I'm a commuter student and I have a 3 hour gap between classes. Is there somewhere on campus I can study or hang out, like a commuter lounge, and is there a way to store my stuff?

body.answer:
J. Lee’s is an unofficial Commuter Lounge for relaxing, with video games, pool and ping pong tables, and free popcorn. It’s on the second floor of the Student Center, between the Student Government and Black Student Union offices. [1] You can also hang out, socialize, and study in the lounge at Room C-220 during open hours. [18] The Student Center Atrium has ample lounging areas. [28]

For storage, rent a small or medium locker at the Student Center Office. Lockers are in the second-floor stairwell area between B and C buildings. The fee is $10.00 per semester or $20.00 per academic year. A key is issued with payment and must be returned at the end of the semester. [6]

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, August 28, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Tuesday, September 1, 2026: Full Semester Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Housing & Residence Life’s guest policy allows each registered guest no more than three nights (consecutively or not) within a seven-day period; a night begins and ends at 10:00 PM. Guests must stay with their resident host and carry valid ID; if staying after 10:00 PM, they need access to their approved Guest Registration email. Residents may host up to two guests at a time. Current residential students do not need guest registration. [3]

Talk with your roommate about expectations. You can contact your Resident Assistant to opt out of automatic guest registration and facilitate a roommate contract. If the contract is violated, staff in the hall/area office must receive a formal complaint before they can act. [3] A complaint about a Guide to Community Living violation should be filed with the Office of Residence Life. [22]

Overnight guests are not permitted on campus after Monday, December 14, 2026. [6]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [31]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [32]

Sources: [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/fallcheckoutandwinter/) [22](https://www.ramapo.edu/policies/policy/student-complaints-of-a-non-academic-nature/) [31](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i get a parking permit and how much does it cost

body.answer:
Public Safety handles parking permits. Apply online through the [Parking Permit Registration](https://rcnjpublicsafety.omnigo.one/CESIReportExec/opr/OPRMain.aspx?IsAuth=1&groupid=102&groupname=PUBLIC+SAFETY) link [1, 8]. To complete the application [1]:
1. Log on to the RCNJ Parking Permits website, enter Permit Type and click Continue.
2. Complete Contact Information; click Save/Update Person, then Continue.
3. Enter Vehicle Information and click Continue.
4. Review your request and click Continue.
5. Print or save the Registration Filed page with your registration request number; it verifies your application, but is not your permit.
Select the correct housing assignment or commuter status, and select “student,” not “faculty/staff.” Each vehicle must be registered with Public Safety. Commuters may register two vehicles on one permit at no additional fee, but only one may be parked on campus at a time [1, 6].
For Fall 2026/Spring 2027, registration was available on or about August 1, 2026; requests submitted before August 1 will not be processed and should be resubmitted [7]. New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In; returning resident students pick them up from their on-campus mailbox. Returning commuters pick them up from the Public Safety ID Office Monday through Friday during normal operating hours, or from the Public Safety Office Main Desk after 3 pm if they email to request a different pickup time [1, 6, 7].
Student Accounts lists the Fall/Spring annual permit at $250 (valid through Spring 2027); the resident parking supplement is $50. A Spring-only permit for a new student is $125; summer-only is $100. There is no fall-only permit. Off-campus students are charged 7% sales tax; on-campus students are exempt. The fee is charged to your student account, not paid when you apply [7, 19].

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/costinfo/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course session: the deadline for full-semester courses has passed, but the Session II deadline is still ahead, as the calendar above shows. A student may not withdraw after the published deadline. [7]

The Registrar handles course withdrawals. Before the deadline, withdraw through Web Self Service using the [instructions](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2026/03/Withdrawing.pdf), or use an online withdrawal form or complete one in the Office of the Registrar. Instructor permission is not required, though discussing it with your professor is encouraged. After processing, a “W” is recorded on your transcript; there is no refund. [1][7] If you have a registration hold, use the Withdrawal Form or email reg@ramapo.edu from your Ramapo email with your first and last name, R#, CRN, subject, course number, section number, and course title. [7]

If extraordinary circumstances beyond your control prevented you from withdrawing by the deadline, you may apply for a late administrative withdrawal through the Office of the Provost. Submit an appeal letter in your own words, supported by official documentation, no later than the last day of classes of the regular fall or spring semester following the term. Explain the circumstances, why you could not follow standard withdrawal procedures or obtain incompletes, and the term you want withdrawn. Typically, approval means W grades in all courses for that term. [8]

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [33]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

body.answer:

**Public Safety \(Non-Emergency\)**

Phones: (201) 684-7432; (201) 684-7789 (Director of Public Safety); (201) 684-7011 (Ramapo College Public Safety TDD) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Offices: C-102 [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Contact note: If there is an imminent danger to a student, or to the community, contact the Public Safety Department at \(201\) 684-6666. **Housing & Residence Life**

value.page_words: If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM or Public Safety after these hours at extension 6666. If utilizing the online system on your own, please send only one request per issue. Our system will send automatic email notifications to the sender when the request is processed, when the status changes and when the work is complete. If you have any questions or concerns regarding your request, you may call our Service Desk at extension 7660; please reference the request number generated by the system when you call. return to top Asbestos: The College Park apartments were built before 1980, and some of their construction materials contain asbestos. Buckeye, Holly, International, Mimosa, Elm, Palm, Redwood, Hickory, Science, Mulberry, and Cypress have been renovated and are asbestos-free. Materials that contain asbestos include floor tiles/mastic and joint compound in walls and ceilings. These materials present no hazard unless they are impaired or disturbed. Puncturing these materials could cause a release of asbestos fibers. Please do not insert nails, tacks, hooks or otherwise impair or disturb the materials. If you notice any damage, please vacate the apartment

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
You don’t have to sign up for direct deposit. Unless you specify otherwise, Ramapo issues a paper check and mails it to your billing/permanent address; checks aren’t mailed to campus mailboxes and can’t be picked up at Student Accounts. A refund is issued for a Title IV aid overpayment credit balance of $1.00 or greater; non-Title IV aid credit balances have a $5.00 threshold. [1]

Direct deposit is free and sends the refund to your checking or savings account. To enroll: [Sign up for Electronic Refunds](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/): [4]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience and locate the Student Account Info card.
2. Click Bill & Payment Suite, then Electronic Refunds under My Profile Setup.
3. Enroll in Two-Step Verification (skip if already completed): in Security Settings, select a passcode method, click Send Code, enter the passcode, and click Verify.
4. In Payment Profile, edit or create a payment method and check the box in Refund Option to designate it for direct deposit. [4]

For help, contact Student Accounts. Once enrolled, the page says refunds can be expected within one to two weeks of submitting the application, for students eligible for a refund. [3]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [32]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill

body.answer:
Contact Student Accounts if you need help. To add your parent: Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)); locate the Student Account Info card; click on Bill & Payment Suite; click on Authorized Users located on the right side of the page in the My Profile Setup section; click on the Add Authorized User tab; enter your parent’s email address, answer questions, and click the Continue button; click the I Agree box, then the Continue button. [4]

If you want them to pay only, select “No” for both “View billing statement” and “View payment history.” [3] They’ll be emailed a link to the Bill and Payment Suite, with a username and password. [3] Authorized users can make payments, receive e-bill email notifications, and join the Ramapo Monthly Payment Plan. They cannot access your stored payment methods, academic records, personal emails, or other personal information. [1] Adding them does not allow Student Accounts to discuss your financial records with them; submit the Registrar’s Office FERPA Waiver form for that permission: [https://www.ramapo.edu/catalog/registration-policies/?ferpa=open](https://www.ramapo.edu/catalog/registration-policies/?ferpa=open). [1][6]

question: how do i set up my campus email and wifi login

body.answer:
**Registrar — email:** Visit [https://password.ramapo.edu/](https://password.ramapo.edu/) and click “Activate E-mail Account.” You will be eligible to set up your account within 24 hours of receiving your Ramapo ID number. [12] MFA is required for Ramapo Gmail. When signing in on a new device, approve the prompt in the Gmail app; trust only devices you own, never public or shared computers. **ResNET — Wi-Fi:** Register the device you’ll use with ResNET before connecting. [20][19] To connect wirelessly, scan for networks and connect. [22] For iPad or Windows 11, choose Ramapo-Secure, enter your Ramapo username and password, then accept/connect to the certificate or warning prompt. [15][23]

For setup help, contact the **IT Help Desk**. [4]

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Contact the Office of Residence Life for room and board changes. [9] Review the Room Change Process: [https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) and the Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar before requesting a change. [1] Submit the Room Change Request Form during the open room change period; the online form is [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog). [2][5]

The form is available Thursday, 11/12/26, and submissions are due by 12:00 pm Tuesday, 11/24/26. Outcomes will be emailed by 4:30 pm Friday, 12/4/26. Approved changes take effect on Spring 2027 Check-in Day, 1/18/27. You must completely vacate your current assignment at the end of Fall semester when you check out. Dates are subject to change. After the open period ends, contact your hall office for guidance. [6]

Changes are not guaranteed; they depend on space and other factors, and professional Residence Life staff make the final decision. [1] If approved, prorated housing charges and applicable meal-plan changes will be assessed and adjusted on your student account. [2] Residence Life reserves the right to reassign students for unresolved conflict, among other reasons. [4]

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [33]
- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [33]

This office can help:

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
Student Accounts offers four- and five-month plans for Spring 2027, beginning November 16, 2026. Enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience before the posted semester payment deadline. Pay the down payment and $60 non-refundable set-up fee when you enroll. The five-month plan requires a 20% down payment; the four-month plan requires 25%. Additional installments are due on the 15th of each month thereafter. [1] You can start at [ENROLL IN PAYMENT PLAN – 4 PAY NOW](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/) or review the [Tuition Payment Plans](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) page. [1][3] The plans do not charge interest. [2] Past-due balances of $500 or more from previous semesters must be paid before you’re eligible; late enrollment may require paying missed installments at enrollment. Missing the payment deadline may result in a $200 late fee and/or course deregistration. [1]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [35]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/options-policies/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/affordability/) [35](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: whats the deadline to file the FAFSA for next year and what does ramapo need from me besides that

body.answer:

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [30]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

The Registrar says a student may not withdraw after the published deadline [15]. The College allows a late administrative withdrawal only when extraordinary circumstances prevented you from following standard procedures, for reasons beyond your control, or you were not granted incompletes. Examples include personal illness, death or care of a terminally ill family member, catastrophic circumstances or natural disaster, or immediate employer-required relocation [16].

For an appeal, submit an appeal letter in your own words with official documentation to the Office of the Provost no later than the last day of classes of the regular (fall or spring) semester following the term you want withdrawn. Explain the circumstances, why you could not use standard withdrawal procedures or obtain incompletes, and the term sought. If you did not apply before the semester ended, explain why. Typically, approved appeals result in W grades for all courses in one term; exceptions may be made [16].

Withdrawing may affect financial aid and satisfactory progress toward graduation [11]. If dropping below full-time status, an Academic Scholarship or Ramapo grant may be reduced or taken away; consult Financial Aid before making that change [5]. Financial Aid says withdrawing from all classes before 60% of the semester ends can require federal aid to be returned, and recommends discussing possible effects with its office [1]. SAP is reviewed annually after spring: students must complete at least 67% of attempted credits; the GPA minimum is 2.0 for undergraduates and 3.0 for graduate students [2]. The pages do not specify how a W is counted for SAP. Contact Financial Aid to discuss your award [1].

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [31]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [31]

question: im a transfer student and i commute, how do i get a parking permit and where do i park

body.answer:
Public Safety’s parking rules say to ensure the parking fee is applied to your student account, then use the [Parking Permits website](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) to apply. [7] Orientation Programs’ FAQ gives these steps: log on; enter Permit Type and click Continue; complete Contact Information, click Save/Update Person, then Continue; enter Vehicle Information and Continue; review your request and Continue; print or save the Registration Filed page with your request number. That page verifies your application; it is not your permit. Select the correct commuter status and “student,” not “faculty/staff.” [1] New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In. [1][7] Commuters receive a rearview mirror hang tag; you may register two vehicles on one permit at no additional fee, but only one may be parked on campus at a time. [1][7]

Commuters may park in B1, B2, or B3. If your assigned lot is full, students may use C1, C2, or D for overflow. Commuters may not leave a vehicle overnight (2am–6am) without prior Public Safety authorization. [12]

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Yes. Each registered guest may stay no more than three (3) nights (consecutively or not) within a seven (7) day period; a night begins and ends at 10:00 PM. Residents may host up to two (2) guests at a time. The policy recommends an open conversation about guest expectations. You can opt out of automatic guest registration by contacting your Resident Assistant to facilitate a roommate contract. If its terms are violated, staff in the hall/area office must receive a formal complaint before they can act; all residents of that space may lose guest privileges until a contract is developed. [3]

Contact Housing & Residence Life. Its page says overnight guests are not permitted on campus after Monday, December 14, 2026; residents with an approved check-out extension may not have guests. [6] For a complaint about an alleged Guide to Community Living violation, file it with the Office of Residence Life. [22]

question: how do i get a parking permit and how much does it cost

body.answer:
Public Safety handles parking permits. Apply online through the [Parking Permits website](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [1, 7]. To complete the application [1]:
1. Log on to the RCNJ Parking Permits website, enter Permit Type, and click Continue.
2. Complete Contact Information; click Save/Update Person, then Continue.
3. Enter Vehicle Information and click Continue.
4. Review your request and click Continue.
5. Print or save the Registration Filed page with your registration request number as application verification. It is not your permit.
Select the correct housing assignment or commuter status, and select “student,” not “faculty/staff” [1]. All students who park on campus need a current, valid permit; register each vehicle. Commuters may register two vehicles on one permit at no additional fee, but only one may be parked on campus at a time [1, 6]. The permit fee is charged to your term bill, not paid when applying [7]. New students pick up permits during New Student Check-In; returning residents use their on-campus mailbox. Returning commuters pick up at the Public Safety ID Office during weekday normal operating hours, or after 3 pm at the Public Safety Main Desk if they email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request another pickup time [1, 7].
For 2026–2027, the annual Fall/Spring permit is $250, valid through Spring 2027. Resident students pay a $50 supplement. Off-campus students are charged 7% sales tax on parking fees; on-campus students are exempt. The College does not provide a fall-only permit [7, 19].

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/costinfo/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course session: the deadline for Session I and full-semester courses has passed; Session II courses may be withdrawn from through November 24, as shown above. [32] After the refund period, withdrawal gives no refund; a “W” is recorded on your transcript once processed. Instructor permission isn’t required, though discussing it with your professor is encouraged. [7]

The Registrar says you can withdraw online through Web Self Service. If you have a registration hold, use the Withdrawal Form or email reg@ramapo.edu from your Ramapo email with your name, R#, CRN, subject, course number, section number, and course title. You may not withdraw after the published deadline. [7]

**Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]

Sources: [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)
