question: something fell off the ceiling in my bathroom and theres a leak. who do I call at night, public safety or facilities?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that. You're not alone, and you can ask for help.

**Facilities Management**

Phones: (201) 684-7660; (201) 684-7670 (Receiving / Storeroom) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Offices: P-FAC [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:30am-4:30pm; Saturday and Sunday: Not published. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: Administrative Offices Monday - Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Contact note: You can submit a request using any of the following methods: Using the TMA iService Desk: Online Service Request Portal By Telephone: 201-684-7660 For Media, ITS and Telecomm requests please visit [https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/](https://helpdesk.ramapo.edu/) If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660. Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)

Report an after-hours or weekend emergency: 1. Report emergencies occurring between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m., or on weekends, to Public Safety at extension 6666. \(page: “Any emergencies that occur between 4:30 p.m. and 7:30 a.m. OR on weekends should be reported to Public Safety at extension 6666.”\) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

Get immediate assistance for an urgent Facilities problem: 1. For no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks or clogs, no heat or AC, lock problems, or health and safety concerns, call the Service Desk at extension 7660. \(page: “If you require immediate assistance, problems such as no power, elevator malfunctions, plumbing leaks/clogs, no heat/AC any lock related problem, or health safety concerns please call the Service Desk at extension 7660.”\) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/service-guide/)

**Public Safety \(Non-Emergency\)**

Phones: (201) 684-7432; (201) 684-7789 (Director of Public Safety); (201) 684-7011 (Ramapo College Public Safety TDD) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Offices: C-102 [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

Hours: Monday to Sunday: 24 hours. Start date: not published. End date: not published. Published note: The Public Safety Department is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/get-support/)

Contact note: If there is an imminent danger to a student, or to the community, contact the Public Safety Department at \(201\) 684-6666. Public Safety Contact Information: secdesk@ramapo.edu Parking Permits: parkingpermits@ramapo.edu [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/)

**Public Safety \(Emergency\)**

Phones: (201) 684-6666; (201) 684-7789 (Director of Public Safety); (201) 684-7011 (Ramapo College Public Safety TDD) [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/)

**Housing & Residence Life**

Contact the right office for a facilities emergency: 1. Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM: call Facilities at 201-684-7660. \(page: “Mon–Fri, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM \| The Office of Facilities \([https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/](https://www.ramapo.edu/facilities/)\) \| 201-684-7660”\) 2. After 4:30 PM and on weekends: call Public Safety at 201-684-6666. \(page: “After 4:30 PM & Weekends \| Public Safety \| 201-684-6666”\) 3. 8:00 PM–12:00 midnight: contact the RA Hall Office. \(page: “8:00 PM–12:00 Midni… [Source](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/)

This office can help:
**Civic and Community Engagement Center**: Phone: (201) 684-7586. Email: ccec@ramapo.edu. Office: SC-213. [1]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: whats my current balance and do i have any holds on my account

body.answer:
I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

I can’t see your personal balance or hold status. To check your current, real-time account activity and balances, log into RCNJ Experience (Web Self-Service) and open the Bill & Payment Suite from the Student Account Info card. You can also run an On-Demand Statement there. [35] Log in periodically, since account balances can change. [40]

Student Accounts says an unpaid outstanding balance results in a Hold Flag; paying the account in full removes that flag. A hold from another office or department may still prevent registration. [4] For help checking your financial standing or account hold, contact Student Accounts. [20]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [47]

question: My RA wrote me up for a candle. what happens now? do i have to go to a hearing

body.answer:
The Guide to Community Living lists use of candles as prohibited conduct, and says students who do not comply may face disciplinary action from the Office of Student Conduct. [20] The listed candle-related sanctions apply when a fire alarm is activated because of disregard of a published policy: a first offense is a $150 fine and completion of a fire safety reflection assignment; a second offense is a $300 fine, disciplinary probation, and possible suspension or loss of housing privileges. [2] Those sanctions are not stated for a candle write-up without an alarm activation. [2,20]

I don’t have verified information that a hearing is required for your specific write-up. Contact the Office of Student Conduct to ask what applies to your case. [1,9] If you are preparing for a disciplinary hearing, its page says you may have an advisor present; the advisor may not speak during the hearing. You may contact the office to arrange to review the file or request it. [1]

- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [47]
- **Office of Student Conduct**: Phone: (201) 684-7869. Email: studentconduct@ramapo.edu. Office: C-212. [47]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/hearing/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/fire-safety/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-conduct/frequently-asked-questions/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [47](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
Student Accounts says a Title IV financial aid credit balance of $1.00 or greater will be refunded; non-Title IV financial aid credit balances are subject to a $5.00 threshold. Unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check mailed to your billing/permanent address—not your campus mailbox, and it cannot be picked up at the office. [1]

Direct deposit is optional, free, and deposits refunds into your checking or savings account. Sign up using the “Sign up for Electronic Refunds” link. [1] To set it up: [3]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience: [https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)
2. Locate the Student Account Info card; click Bill & Payment Suite; click Electronic Refunds under My Profile Setup.
3. Enroll in Two-Step Verification (skip if already completed): in My Profile, select Security Settings, choose a passcode method, click Send Code, enter the passcode, and click Verify.
4. In Payment Profile, edit or create a payment method, then check the Refund Option box to designate it for direct deposit.

Student Accounts’ direct-deposit page says refunds are deposited within one to two weeks of submitting the application, for students eligible for a refund. [2] For help, contact Student Accounts.

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [32]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill

body.answer:
Student Accounts: Log into RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)), locate the Student Account Info card, click “Bill & Payment Suite,” then “Authorized Users” on the right side of the page in the My Profile Setup section. If you want your parent to make payments only, select “No” for both “View billing statement” and “View payment history.” [3] Your parent will be emailed a link to the Bill and Payment Suite, along with a username and password. [3]

It does not authorize Student Accounts to discuss your financial records with them. question: how do i set up my campus email and wifi login

body.answer:
For email, the Registrar says new students can visit [https://password.ramapo.edu/](https://password.ramapo.edu/) and click “Activate E-mail Account”; you are eligible within 24 hours of receiving your Ramapo ID number. A valid Ramapo email account is required to register for classes. [12] MFA is required for Ramapo Gmail. When you sign in on a new device, approve the prompt in the Gmail app; trust only devices you own, never public or shared computers. [4] Two-factor authentication is in effect now: February 28, 2023 has passed. [14]

For Wi-Fi, ResNET says students must register the device they want to use before it can connect to the college network; once registered, it can be used campus-wide. [3] First determine whether you’ll use wired or wireless, then retrieve that connection’s MAC address. [20] Register at [https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/) using the wired or wireless option: [https://resnet.ramapo.edu/register/login.php](https://resnet.ramapo.edu/register/login.php) or [http://mydevices.ramapo.edu/](http://mydevices.ramapo.edu/). [19] After registration, scan for wireless networks and connect. [22] A valid Ramapo email account and a device capable of wireless or wired connectivity are required for ResNET. [6]

For email technical help, contact the IT Help Desk. [12] For Wi-Fi registration, contact ResNET. [19]

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Contact the Office of Residence Life; all room and board changes must go through that office. [9]

1. Review the [Room Change Process](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) and the [Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/) to understand how a change might affect you. Requests aren’t guaranteed; they depend on available space and other factors, and professional Residence Life staff make the final decision. The College reserves the right to authorize or deny changes and may reassign students for unresolved conflict. [1, 4]

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

question: How do I set up a payment plan for spring semester tuition? and is there a fee to enroll in it

body.answer:
For Spring 2027, enroll online by logging into RCNJ Experience before the semester’s posted payment deadline. Ramapo offers four- and five-month plans. At enrollment, pay the non-refundable $60 set-up fee and the down payment: 25% for the four-month plan or 20% for the five-month plan. Additional installments are due on the 15th of each month thereafter. You may enroll after the down-payment due date, but must pay any missed installments when enrolling. Past-due balances of $500 or more from previous semesters must be paid before you’re eligible; the College may also deny enrollment based on past payment history. Plans do not charge interest. [1][2]

Students who miss the payment deadline may be subject to a $200 late fee and/or course deregistration. [1]

The Office of Student Accounts provides plan information and assistance. [1]

question: whats the deadline to file the FAFSA for next year and what does ramapo need from me besides that

body.answer:
For the 2027-2028 FAFSA, returning students should apply by April 1st; new students should apply no later than May 1st. [19]

question: what is the policy on withdrawing from a class after the deadline and does it affect my aid/satisfactory academic progress

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [30]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

A student may not withdraw after the published deadline [15]. For extraordinary circumstances that prevented a timely withdrawal, the Office of the Provost accepts late administrative withdrawal appeals. Submit an appeal letter in your own words, supported by official documentation, no later than the last day of classes of the regular semester following the term. Explain the extraordinary circumstances, why standard procedures could not be followed (or incompletes were not obtained), and the term. Typically, an approved appeal results in W grades for all courses in that term; exceptions may be considered in extraordinary circumstances [16].

Withdrawing from a course may affect financial aid and satisfactory progress toward graduation [11]. Financial Aid says federal aid should not be affected if you remain enrolled in 6 or more credits after the refund period; NJ State aid requires full-time enrollment when the aid is fully disbursed. It recommends discussing your aid with Financial Aid before withdrawing [41]. SAP is reviewed annually after spring; students must complete at least 67% of credits attempted, and undergraduate/graduate students must meet cumulative GPAs of 2.0/3.0, respectively [2]. The college pages don't establish the effect on your individual aid or SAP status; contact Financial Aid to discuss your situation [1][41].

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [49]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [49]

I can't see your personal records, like your grades, balance, schedule or financial aid status.

I can’t verify whether your individual form is available. Ramapo provides 1098-T forms each year on or before January 31, for students who incurred qualified tuition and related expenses and paid corresponding payments during the tax year. Student Accounts says forms are not mailed. To view or print yours, “Log into RCNJ Experience” ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)); “Locate the Student Account Info card”; “Click on the Bill & Payment Suite link”; “Click on the My Account tab at the top of the screen and select Statements”; “Click on the 1098-T Tax Statements tab”; then “Click the View button for the appropriate tax year.” The PDF can be printed or saved. It will be printed within 5-7 business days and mailed to the home address on file with the Registrar’s Office. [1]

question: im a transfer student and i commute, how do i get a parking permit and where do i park

body.answer:
All students parking on campus need a current, valid permit. The Orientation Programs FAQ directs students to apply online at the [RCNJ Parking Permits website](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/). Follow these steps: [1]
1. “Log on directly to the RCNJ Parking Permits website.”
2. “Enter Permit Type and click Continue.”
3. “Complete the Contact Information page, and then click Save/Update Person and then click Continue.”
4. “Enter Vehicle Information and then click Continue.”
5. “Review your request and then click Continue.”
6. “Print or save the Registration Filed page,” which includes your request number and serves as application verification—not as your permit. Select the correct commuter status. [1]
Ensure the parking fee has been applied to your student account. New-student permits are available for pickup during New Student Check-In; returning commuter permits are picked up at the Public Safety ID Office during normal weekday hours, or at the Public Safety Office Main Desk after 3 pm if you email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request another pickup time. [7] Commuters may register two vehicles on one permit at no additional fee, but only one registered vehicle may be parked on campus at a time. [1][7] Off-campus students are charged 6.63% sales tax on parking fees. [25]
As a commuter, park in B1, B2, or B3. If your assigned lot is full, students may use C1, C2, or D as overflow. [12]

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [25](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/parking/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: I'm a commuter student and I have a 3 hour gap between classes. Is there somewhere on campus I can study or hang out, like a commuter lounge, and is there a way to store my stuff?

body.answer:
For hanging out, J. Lee’s is the unofficial Commuter Lounge, on the second floor of the Student Center between the Student Government office and the Black Student Union office. It has video games, a pool table, ping pong, and free popcorn. [1] The Women’s Center lounge in C-220 welcomes students to hang out, socialize, or study during open hours. The Student Center Atrium also has ample lounging areas. [18][28]

To store belongings, rent a small or medium locker at the Student Center Office. Lockers are in the second-floor stairwell area between B and C buildings. question: what is the deadline to drop a class without a W and how do i do it

body.answer:
I can't send messages or make changes for you, like registering, dropping a class or making a payment.

The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [31]:
- Friday, August 28, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)
- Tuesday, September 1, 2026: Full Semester Courses - Last Day of Add/Drop for 100% Tuition Refund (already passed)

question: my roommate keeps having his girlfriend sleep over like 5 nights a week. is there a guest policy and who do i talk to about it

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Yes. Each registered guest may stay on campus no more than three nights (consecutively or not) within a seven-day period; a night begins and ends at 10:00 PM. The guest must remain with the resident host, and guests’ behavior should conform to the wishes of all residents in the room, suite or apartment. Five nights a week exceeds the stated limit. [3][4]

Housing & Residence Life: The College recommends discussing guest expectations with your roommate. You can contact your Resident Assistant to opt out of automatic guest registration and facilitate a roommate contract. If the contract is violated, staff in the hall/area office must receive a formal complaint before they can act; a complaint may result in all residents of the space losing guest privileges until a contract is developed. [3] The Office of Residence Life handles alleged violations of the Guide to Community Living. [22]

The last night residents may host overnight guests this fall is Monday, December 14, 2026; overnight guests are not permitted on campus after that date. [6]

**Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [31]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [32]

question: how do i get a parking permit and how much does it cost

body.answer:
**Public Safety** handles parking permits. Apply online through [Parking Permits](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [1, 12]. The current registration link is “Click Here for Parking Permit Registration” [8]. All students must apply online [1]. Select the correct housing assignment or commuter status, and select “student,” not “faculty/staff” [1]. Check that the parking fee has been applied to your student account [6]; it automatically appears on your term bill [7, 12]. New-student permits are picked up during New Student Check-In; returning resident students pick them up from their on-campus mailbox. Returning commuter students pick them up from the Public Safety ID Office Monday through Friday during normal operating hours, or from the Public Safety Office Main Desk after 3 pm if they email parkingpermits@ramapo.edu to request a different pick-up time [1, 6, 7]. Commuters may register two vehicles on one permit at no additional fee, but only one registered vehicle may be on campus at a time [1, 6].

For 2026–2027, the annual Fall/Spring permit is $250.00. Off-campus students are charged a $16.58 commuter parking tax; on-campus students are exempt. Resident students also have a $50.00 parking supplement [19]. The parking-fee page gives the off-campus sales tax as 6.63%, while Public Safety lists it as 7%; these pages differ [12, 7].

- **Orientation Programs**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: orient@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [29]
- **Public Safety (Non-Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-7432. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]
- **Public Safety (Emergency)**: Phone: (201) 684-6666. Email: publicsafety@ramapo.edu. Office: C-102. [29]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/orientation/faq-2/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-regulations/) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/publicsafety/parking-permits/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/parking/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/costinfo/) [29](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: is it too late to withdraw from a class this semester and what happens to my transcript if i do

body.answer:
The Fall 2026 academic calendar lists [32]:
- Friday, October 2, 2026: Session I Courses - Last Day to Withdraw ("W" Grade) (already passed)
- Friday, November 6, 2026: Full Semester Courses – Last Day to Withdraw from Courses (“W” Grade) (already passed)
- Tuesday, November 24, 2026: Session II Courses - Last Day to Withdraw from Courses ("W" Grade)

It depends on the course session: the full-semester withdrawal deadline has passed, but a Session II course may still be withdrawn from by its deadline above. A student may not withdraw after the published deadline. [7] After the refund period, there is no refund. [7]

If you withdraw by the deadline, the Registrar records a “W” on your transcript after processing the withdrawal. You can withdraw through Web Self Service; the page links to its instructions. If you have a registration hold, use the Withdrawal Form or email reg@ramapo.edu from your Ramapo email with your name, R#, CRN, subject, course number, section number, and course title. Instructor permission is not required, though discussing it with your professor is encouraged. [7] Withdrawal can affect financial aid eligibility, progress toward graduation, athletic compliance, housing, and campus activities. [1]

If extraordinary circumstances beyond your control prevented you from withdrawing through standard procedures, the Office of the Provost accepts applications for late administrative withdrawal. Submit an appeal letter in your own words, with official documentation, by the last day of classes of the regular semester following the term. Explain the circumstances, why you could not follow standard procedures or obtain an incomplete, and the term for which you seek withdrawal. Typically, an approved appeal results in W grades for all courses in the term. [8]

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]
- **Office of the Provost**: Phone: (201) 684-7330. Email: provost@ramapo.edu. Location: first floor of the Birch Mansion. [33]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/pages/R532kjMfIcfnIkM0srb3#dropping-or-withdrawing-from-a-course1) [7](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [8](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/withdrawing-leave-of-absence/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/academic-calendars/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: My RA wrote me up for a candle. what happens now? do i have to go to a hearing

body.answer:
Candles are prohibited in campus housing. A prohibited item may be confiscated and not returned; Residence Life says the immediate fine starts at $50.00 per item for each resident deemed responsible. Additional fines or disciplinary sanctions may follow if further violations are found. [20][37][40] If the candle caused a fire alarm to activate, the listed first-offense outcome is a $150.00 fine and completion of a fire safety reflection assignment. [2]

The pages don’t say whether your specific write-up requires a hearing. Contact the Office of Student Conduct to ask what applies to your case. If a hearing is scheduled, you may request an appointment to review the reports and statements that will be used, and may bring an advisor who can confer with you but cannot speak during the hearing. [1]

- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [49]

question: I got a credit balance on my student account after my aid posted, how do I get that money sent to me? Do I need to sign up for direct deposit or does it just get mailed?

body.answer:
Student Accounts: If a Title IV financial aid overpayment creates a credit balance of $1.00 or greater, a refund will be issued; non-Title IV financial aid credit balances have a $5.00 threshold. Unless you specify otherwise, the College issues a paper check mailed to your billing/permanent address. Checks aren’t mailed to campus mailboxes and can’t be picked up at Student Accounts. [1]

Direct deposit is optional and free. To use it, follow these steps: [1][3][4]
1. Log into RCNJ Experience: [https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)
2. Locate the Student Account Info card; click on Bill & Payment Suite.
3. Click on Electronic Refunds on the right hand side of the screen under the My Profile Setup menu.
4. Enroll in Two-Step Verification (skip if previously completed): in My Profile, click Security Settings, select a passcode method (text message, email or Google Authentication), click Send Code, enter the passcode, then click Verify.
5. Click the Payment Profile tab in My Profile. Edit an existing payment method or create a new one, then check the box in the Refund Option section to designate the account for direct deposit.

Direct deposit refunds are expected within one to two weeks after submitting the application. [3]

**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [32]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/deposits/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit-questions-answers/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/direct-deposit/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i add my parent as an authorized user so they can pay my bill

body.answer:
Student Accounts: In RCNJ Experience ([https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/](https://experience.elluciancloud.com/rconj/)), locate the Student Account Info card, click “Bill & Payment Suite,” then “Authorized Users” on the right side of the page in “My Profile Setup.” Click “Add Authorized User,” enter your parent’s email address, answer the questions, and click “Continue.” Click the “I Agree” box, then “Continue.” [4]

If you want your parent to make payments only, select “No” for both “View billing statement” and “View payment history.” [3] Your parent will be emailed a link to the Bill and Payment Suite, along with a username and password. [3]

question: I lost my ID card, how do I get a replacement

body.answer:

question: how do i set up my campus email and wifi login

body.answer:
**Email — IT Help Desk:** Visit [https://password.ramapo.edu/](https://password.ramapo.edu/) and click “Activate E-mail Account.” New students are eligible to set up email within 24 hours of receiving their Ramapo ID number. [12] Two-factor authentication (2FA) is required for Ramapo Gmail. [4][9] Sign in and approve the prompt in the Gmail app; trust only your own devices. [2][4] The page’s instruction to follow ITS’s 2FA setup instructions to maintain email access is in effect now. [14]

**Wi-Fi — ResNET:** You need a valid Ramapo email account and a wireless-capable device. [6] Register your connection using the device you’ll use before connecting to the college network. [3] Choose “wireless” at [https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/); registration requires the connection’s MAC address. [19][20] To connect, scan for wireless networks and connect. [22] For an iPad, choose Ramapo-Secure in Settings > Wi-Fi, enter your Ramapo username and password, then accept the certificate warning. [15] Windows 11 instructions are on [https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/secure-wireless/](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/secure-wireless/). [23]

- **Registrar**: Phone: (201) 684-7695. Email: reg@ramapo.edu. Office: D-224. [33]
- **IT Help Desk**: Phone: (201) 684-7777. Email: helpdesk@ramapo.edu. Location: 4th floor of the Learning Commons. [33]

Sources: [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/its/mfa/) [3](https://www.ramapo.edu/its/faqs/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/its/email-activation-and-information/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/its/faqs/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/its/mfa/) [12](https://www.ramapo.edu/registrar/online-course-information/) [14](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-affairs/how-to-access-your-ramapo-e-mail-as-of-february-28th/) [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/secure-wireless/) [19](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/) [20](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/register/) [22](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/faq/) [23](https://www.ramapo.edu/resnet/secure-wireless/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: how do i switch roommates? we're not getting along at all

body.answer:
Roommate problems are really common, and they can be worked out. Your RA is a good first step.

Contact the Office of Residence Life: room and board changes must go through that office [9]. Review the [Room Change Process](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) and the [Residence Life Events & Important Dates calendar](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/critical-housing-dates-deadlines-calendar/) before applying [1]. Submit the [Online Room Change Request Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSflQtcwyqtigPCfHGI4IOscg7Zfp10vRzMMR34xv7_MDjyb6A/viewform?usp=dialog) during the open room change period [2][5]. The form is available Thursday, 11/12/26; submissions are due by 12:00 pm Tuesday, 11/24/26. Outcome responses are sent by email by 4:30 pm Friday, 12/4/26. Approved students move to new assignments on Spring 2027 Check-in Day, 1/18/27, and must completely vacate their current assignment at the end of Fall semester when they check out. Dates are subject to change [6]. Changes are not guaranteed; approval depends on available space and other factors, and professional Residence Life staff make the final decision [1]. If approved, prorated housing charges and any applicable meal-plan changes will be assessed and adjusted on your student account [2]. Residence Life reserves the right to reassign students for unresolved conflict [4].

- **Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [33]
- **Housing & Residence Life**: Phone: (201) 684-7461. Email: reslife@ramapo.edu. [33]

This office can help:
**Ombuds Office**: Phone: (201) 684-7804. Email: jwoods1@ramapo.edu. [34]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [2](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/new-student-guide/) [4](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/gtcl/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [6](https://www.ramapo.edu/reslife/rcp/) [9](https://www.ramapo.edu/student-accounts/faq/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [34](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: Missed 3 classes last week because I was in the hospital. How do I get my professors to excuse the absences, is there an office that sends a note or something?

body.answer:
I'm sorry you're dealing with that, and I hope you feel better soon.

For absences due to a medical disability, OSS says it can consult with students and faculty about what is appropriate. It does not say that OSS sends an excuse note. [15] Contact each professor after an absence to account for it and ask if and when missed work may be made up. Each instructor sets their own attendance policy. [15] I don’t have verified information about whether an office can excuse these hospitalization-related absences or issue a note.

**Office of Specialized Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7514. Email: oss@ramapo.edu. Location: C-Wing, Room 205. [52]

These offices can help:
- **Health Services**: Phone: (201) 684-7536. Location: Near the campus South Gate entrance at the corner of Route 202 and Hornbeam Road. [53]
- **Center for Student Success (Academic Advising)**: Phone: (201) 684-7441. Email: success@ramapo.edu. Office: D-207. [53]

Sources: [15](https://www.ramapo.edu/oss/disabilities-and-teaching-strategies-accommodations/) [52](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [53](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)

question: can alumni still use career services and the library after graduating

body.answer:
Yes. Alumni can access the Cahill Career Center’s services on campus, including job-search help, resume updates and interviewing skills. For more information, contact the Cahill Career Center at (201) 684-7444 or careercenter@ramapo.edu. [2] Alumni also receive career guidance and help with resume updates. [9] The Career Development Office’s support extends to all Ramapo alumni. [12]

Alumni can use the library’s online services, borrow books and access the Learning Commons. Visit the library at [https://www.ramapo.edu/library/](https://www.ramapo.edu/library/) or download the Library Benefits document at [https://www.ramapo.edu/alumni/wp-content/uploads/sites/195/2013/08/Library-Benefits.doc](https://www.ramapo.edu/alumni/wp-content/uploads/sites/195/2013/08/Library-Benefits.doc) for more information. [1]

question: how do i get a work study job on campus? i have it in my aid package but idk where to apply

body.answer:
Money stress is really common, and you don't have to sort it out alone.

On-Campus Employment for Students: Register on Handshake ([https://ramapo.joinhandshake.com/](https://ramapo.joinhandshake.com/)) to view open on-campus jobs. Search using the keyword “RCNJ,” follow the application instructions in each posting, and contact the listed supervisor. FWS recipients receive priority for Student Assistant positions. [5] You and the supervisor discuss the position; if you’re offered it and accept, you both sign an employment form. Return the required new-hire packet, W-4 Form, and I-9 Form to the Student Assistant Program Office, Room D-119. [1] For questions about your Federal Work-Study award, contact Financial Aid at finaid@ramapo.edu. [5]

**On-Campus Employment for Students**: Phone: (201) 684-7654. Email: sap@ramapo.edu. Office: D-119. [32]

This office can help:
**Student Accounts**: Phone: (201) 684-7495. Email: studentaccts@ramapo.edu. Location: D-Wing, First Floor. [33]

Sources: [1](https://www.ramapo.edu/on-campus-employment/policies-and-procedures/) [5](https://www.ramapo.edu/on-campus-employment/) [32](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/) [33](https://www.ramapo.edu/campus-directory/)
